facts: Founder Prof. Amnon Shashua informed Mobileye's board that he intends to step down as CEO upon appointment of a successor after 27 years leading the company.
The board said it will hire an executive search firm and conduct a comprehensive CEO search; Shashua remains a director and has been offered the Chairman role after a new CEO is appointed.
The issuer said the transition is intended to preserve continuity of leadership, strategy and execution while positioning the company for its next growth phase.
Mobileye stated that Intel beneficially owns approximately 77% of the company, preserving a controlling-shareholder governance consideration during succession.

factors.name: governancePower
factors.basis: A founder-CEO succession process introduces key-person and transition uncertainty while Shashua is expected to remain involved as director and potentially Chairman; Intel's approximately 77% beneficial ownership remains a concentrated governance feature.

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: Council Alpha should treat CEO appointment, transition timing and continuity across ADAS, robotaxi and humanoid-robotics programs as explicit execution checkpoints rather than assuming uninterrupted founder-led execution.

risks.risk: Founder-CEO succession can create strategic, organizational and execution discontinuity during a period when Mobileye is simultaneously expanding advanced ADAS, vertically integrated robotaxi operations and humanoid robotics.

The proposed continued role for Shashua and Intel's approximately 77% beneficial ownership may support continuity but also preserve concentrated governance influence for minority shareholders to evaluate.

contradictions: The board characterizes the succession as continuity-oriented, but the successor is not yet identified; continuity is therefore an intention rather than an observed outcome.
unknowns: Who will be appointed CEO and on what timetable.
Whether Shashua will ultimately accept and assume the Chairman role after a successor is appointed.
Whether the transition changes capital allocation, product priorities, commercialization timelines or management retention across the automotive and Physical AI businesses.
